name: Maximum Subarray (Kadane's Algorithm)
description:
Given an integer array `nums`, find the subarray with the largest sum, and return its sum.

Kadane's Algorithm solves this problem in linear time O(N) by calculating the maximum subarray ending at each position.
hints: Maintain two variables: `maxSoFar := nums[0]` and `currentMax := nums[0]`.
For each subsequent number `x` in nums[1:], `currentMax = max(x, currentMax + x)`.
